scope.message_rule: Only citation-bearing messages are in the occurrence ledger: three r1 messages plus one r2 message; citation-free archive messages remain out of scope.
scope.identity_rule: Every placeholder is mapped to exact archive turn, message item and index. Original citation URLs were not exposed by either export.

provenance_policy.supplemental_evidence: Checked official product documentation or project primary repositories after export. These URLs supplement the claim and do not restore the original search result.
provenance_policy.installation_policy: register_only; no tool, app, plugin, account or subscription was installed or activated by this catalog work.
provenance_policy.claim_rule: Record product self-description and concrete limits; do not treat availability of an API/CLI/MCP as authorization to perform writes.
provenance_policy.legal_finance_rule: For legal/financial claims, distinguish product workflow grammar from jurisdiction-specific law; mark partial unless the cited official source directly supports the applicable requirement.
provenance_policy.evidence_fields: evidence_url is the durable public URL checked for this source; locator records the page section or reading range. Internal web-tool IDs are intentionally omitted.

occurrences.claim: AWS KYC 参考架构拆分身份验证、文档分析、欺诈检测、合规与风险、客户体验，并把低置信或复杂 case 路由到人工 case management。
occurrences.note: AWS 官方架构博客直接列出五类子任务、置信度路由和人工审查；置信度阈值是示例，不是法定标准。

occurrences.claim: 金融信贷工作流可从客户材料抽取开始，计算财务指标并做信用分析，形成 draft credit memo，由人负责最终决策；同时需要把 FCRA/消费者保护、KYC/AML、公平信贷和可解释性当作法域相关约束。
occurrences.note: Microsoft 官方场景直接支持抽取材料、计算比率、评估信用评级、生成 draft memo；CFPB/FinCEN/BIS 只分别支持美国不利行动、CDD/受益所有权与金融 AI 可解释性背景，不能替代目标法域法律审查或恢复原 Microsoft citation。

occurrences.claim: 监管问询 grammar 需要跨 PDF/PPT/Word/CSV 等历史材料检索，持续多轮修改，并保留 retrieval、模型行为和用户交互的可观察性。
occurrences.note: AWS 官方 Amazon Finance 案例直接支持多格式历史材料、跨轮上下文、检索与 OpenTelemetry/Langfuse 观测；这是公开案例架构，不是所有金融机构的合规基线。

occurrences.claim: 法律与金融共同需要 exception/evidence/decision/approval review space；高风险流程应保留人工验证、升级路径和人类 override audit trail。
occurrences.note: 这是跨领域设计综合；BIS 讨论可解释性、CFPB 说明复杂算法不免除具体理由义务，但两者都不建立“所有金融高风险流程统一要求完整 override audit trail”的普遍规则，需按法域核查。
